channels: background grpc.SharedChannel with per-RPC or OOB ORCA
scope.scheduler: grpc-core static-stride scaling with unknown-weight mean substitution, 10x upper cap, 1% lower bound and independent RR fallback
scope.ordinary_oob_boundary: a single-owner Channel cannot safely drive a background OOB stream and therefore uses RR fallback when enableOobLoadReport is true; SharedChannel owns that mode

implementation.service_config: all grpc-core fields and defaults are parsed; weightUpdatePeriod is clamped to 100 ms; custom utilization metric names are owned for the Channel lifetime
implementation.ordinary_channel: every physical transparent or configured retry re-enters endpoint selection, computes grpc-timeout after readiness, and consumes the selected endpoint's per-RPC report
implementation.shared_channel: worker weight mutation and scheduler reads share the channel mutex; a static-stride sequence advances only when the selected worker claims the RPC
implementation.snapshot_safety: rebuild allocation reserves before replacing the prior scheduler, resolver replacement invalidates stable pointers, and disconnect generations reject stale snapshots
implementation.fallback: zero/expired weights, fewer than two available endpoints, allocation failure and OOB-without-owner retain deterministic READY-only RR admission

results.ordinary_per_rpc_distribution: two real HTTP/2 endpoints completed 200 measured unary RPCs with endpoint weights 1:3; the higher-weight endpoint received more than 2x and less than 4x the lower-weight count
results.ordinary_expiration_fallback: after reports stopped and the 2-second expiration elapsed, 40 real unary RPCs split exactly 20/20
results.ordinary_retry_repick: a trailers-only UNAVAILABLE from endpoint A caused physical attempt two to select endpoint B with grpc-previous-rpc-attempts=1
results.shared_oob_distribution: two real SharedChannel endpoints completed the same 200-RPC 1:3 bound and exact 40-RPC expiration fallback
results.official_regression_matrix: grpc-cpp h2c, certificate-verified TLS and both pick-first failover paths passed; 9/9 build steps succeeded

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='weighted round robin' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='Channel weighted round robin' -Dtest-filter='Channel retry repicks' --summary all
remaining_gap: Weighted round robin is covered for ordinary and shared channels. Composite priority, weighted-target and xDS control-plane policies remain separate work.
